result.reason: The redline cleanly satisfies every preferred requirement: Customer receives a 30-day written termination-for-convenience right, prepaid Fees for the unused period are refunded, and Vendor is barred from terminating for convenience during a committed term. It is minimal and leaves the existing for-cause rights intact. The fallback is not independently satisfied because the Customer notice period is shorter than 60 days and the clause lacks an express end-of-term, 90-day-notice mechanism for Vendor. Drafting quality is high, though numbering the new paragraph as Section 9.4 would improve structural clarity.
